Could you please elaborate on your concern regarding the charging session? I'm not fully understanding the issue you're describing. Currently, the charger is working fine, and the EV is charging on DC outlet 1. Are you asking if it's acceptable for the EV to remain connected to the charger after the SOC reaches 100%, or are you indicating that no EV is connected, yet the system shows the EV is connected and logs reflect a charging session? It would be helpful if you could provide more details. If there was any charging session that was aborted, please share the date and time so we can analyze it and provide the root cause.
For future reference, your case number is
0398461
, please do refer to this in all further communication regarding this issue.
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.

additional_info.subject: RE: AW: ID0398461-DC/Si-D/DE-[MP / S1 170003220] Charging Issue CRM:00643001197
additional_info.body:
Hallo
Der charger hält eine session solange aufrecht, bis das Fahrzeug die Session beendet. Wenn vom Fahrzeug keine kommunikation zum charger vorhanden ist, wird die Session beendet.
Der Controller versucht immer mit dem Fahrzeug zu kommunizieren wenn aber das Fahrzeug im ruhezustand ist und kein signal an den charger sendet, wird die session nicht weiter geführt. In Ihrem fall müsste es über mehrere tage hinweg dafür gesorgt werden das die communikation erhalten bleibt.
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team
Please do not change the subject of this Email when replying to it.
